interpretation: Diagnostic instrumentation only. syncClockMs uses the Object I/O clock and can include a stale starting timestamp, alarm precommit scheduling and resumption. It does not isolate disk or replication cost. Caller RPC and driver spans are separate clock domains; overlapping spans are not summed.
